## Tabla de Suelo Agrupado

```{r}
#| label: suelo_agrupado
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(here)
library(dplyr)
# install.packages("kableExtra")
library(kableExtra)

suelo_agrupado <- read.csv(here("data", "suelo_agrupado.csv"))

suelo_agrupado |>
  # 1. Select only the columns needed for the presentation to save space
  select(ETIQUETA, TXTPLAN, area_ha) |> 
  
  # 2. Build the basic table using kbl() (which replaces knitr::kable)
  kbl(
    booktabs = TRUE, # Cleaner LaTeX table style
    col.names = c("Etiqueta", "Descripción", "Área (ha)"),
    digits = 1       # Round decimal numbers
  ) |>
  
  # 3. Apply LaTeX styling to scale down and shrink the font
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("scale_down"),
    font_size = 6
  ) |>
  
  # 4. Force the long text description column to wrap to a specific width
  column_spec(2, width = "5.5cm")
```
